// diagnostic

E0421

`` `uninit` needs an explicit type ``.

What

`` `uninit` needs an explicit type ``.

Why

An uninitialized binding has no value to infer its type from, so the type must appear before the literal body.

Fix

Write `` `{name} := <Type>{ uninit }` ``, e.g. `` `buffer := [U8#4096]{ uninit }` ``.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0421: tests/ui/uninit_no_type.stderr.
